crossRefs.note: Let them vanish like water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.
Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.
Pass through your land like the Nile, daughter of Tarshish. There is no restraint any more.
You will be cursed in the city, and you will be cursed in the field.
Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.
Yahweh’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.
If you will not listen, and if you will not take it to heart, to give glory to my name,” says Yahweh of Armies, “then I…

translations.web: “They are foam on the surface of the waters. Their portion is cursed in the earth. They don’t turn into the way of the vineyards.
translations.bsb: They are but foam on the surface of the water; their portion of the land is cursed, so that no one turns toward their vineyards.
translations.kjv: He is swift as the waters; their portion is cursed in the earth: he beholdeth not the way of the vineyards.
translations.asv: Swiftly they pass away upon the face of the waters; Their portion is cursed in the earth: They turn not into the way of the vineyards.
